failures.what: The kit's Hours renders a screen-reader-only <caption class="sr-only">; the gate's measure step reports it as text wider than its box and clipped at every width (all 10 cases). Second failing run was a rerun to list any other problems; there were none.

wanted: The browser gate should skip visually hidden elements (sr-only: 1px box, clip) in its overflow and clipping checks. Until then the kit's Hours cannot pass the gate; this block builds the same table from the kit's hoursRows with a visible 'Opening hours' caption instead.

A kit SpecialHours piece. Special dates are formatted here with Intl and Date.UTC; a published page cannot know today's date, so past dates stay listed until the site is republished. The renderer should filter special hours to upcoming dates.
className (or a tap-size option) on PhoneLink, EmailLink and MapLink: the links themselves are one text line tall; only their list items are min-h-tap.
A rule for which facts gate the location note and the booking link. Here the note shows with address or map, and the booking link with phone or email.
notes: Contract checks passed first time; the only browser failure was the kit's sr-only caption. With one location, missing location phone or email falls back to the business's own; with several it never does.
